validation.evidence: After PUT /api/v1/admin/users/<synthetic-user>/activate {activate_status:off}, independent GET admin/users confirmed is_active:0. The preexisting web session returned HTTP 401; a new password login returned HTTP 200/code403 disabled. The unchanged API key still read private dataset B (HTTP 200/code0) and downloaded B's original text, including unique synthetic marker CODEX_PRIVATE_e0b02e8db69767e8ac8d, through Nginx. The unchanged beta key still read shared-app info (HTTP 200/code0) through Nginx and listed both datasets through diagnostic container-loopback MCP. No new key was issued after deactivation.
validation.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: The proven scope is the deactivated user's own previously authorized data, not arbitrary other tenants. MCP text retrieval was blocked by the offline embedding dependency. Reactivation/key-reissue policy and a remediated build were not tested; no patch was applied.
